q: Why is there a gap in 2026?
a: Boomer paused scheduled streams in early 2026 to build this website. Surprise streams still happened and are counted, from Boomer's own stream sheet. Nothing was recorded between the last sheet entry and the first automatic reading, so the chart shades that stretch instead of guessing.
Close to it. Every morning at 5 am Pacific the site reads Twitch, YouTube and TikTok and updates this page. TikTok is typed in by hand until TikTok approves the site's app.

q: What counts as a new follower?
a: The change in a platform's total during the month, added up across platforms. When a platform is added (YouTube in August 2025), its existing followers are a starting balance, not new ones.

q: Why does YouTube move in steps?
a: Above 1,000 subscribers YouTube only shares rounded counts, so its line climbs in small steps.
